protocol: E98 PROTOCOL.md section 6, unchanged (a criterion that is partial or cannot be verified counts as failed; a passing build or test suite is not evidence of forecasting validity)

criteria.criterion: Target and geographic scope match the claims
criteria.evidence: Chapter I asks for province-level food-insecurity classification. No provincial measured outcome exists: the PSA FIES 2021/2023 PUFs have no food-insecurity-experience module (E99 Q4). The only quarterly outcome is regional, and it is survey-specific: SWS and OCTA agree on the class in 3 of 7 common quarters, kappa 0.0 (E99 Q1).

criteria.criterion: Lead-2 evaluated against the approved outcome with a defensible design
criteria.evidence: Regional Lead-2 0.933 (14/15) is development evidence on a regional, survey-specific outcome. A 2-quarter moving average of SWS also reaches 0.80 (E99 Q2), so clearing 75% alone does not show added value. FIRI's edge rests on 5 transition quarters (4/5 vs persistence 1/5).

criteria.criterion: Temporal leakage and forecast alignment checked
criteria.evidence: E97 Q1b-Q1d (90 rows, 0 mismatches); E98 D audit; the E99 MA rules use only rounds posted before each issue date (TS._posted).

criteria.criterion: 75% not claimed as independently met on development quarters; independent evidence present
criteria.evidence: Not claimed. Independent evidence absent: the sealed 2026-Q4 and 2027-Q1 forecasts are PENDING (prospective/status_20261022.json), and a 75% claim needs at least 12 scored quarters even if all are correct.
E99 Q2 on the E98 common quarters (15 at Lead 2, 16 at Lead 1); E97 Q5 same 65 rows per lead.

criteria.criterion: Any displayed probability has defensible calibration
criteria.evidence: On this branch: the price score, the hunger outlook, FIRI and the LGU index are labelled as 0-1 scores or indices, not probabilities. Label audit: 0 hits over 71 thesis-mode API payloads covering every endpoint the frontend calls (label_audit_after.json); before the change, 217 hits over 68 payloads (label_audit_before.json). Remaining percentages are PAGASA's own ENSO probabilities, quoted as PAGASA's. Production still shows the old wording (this branch is not deployed).

criteria.criterion: Feature groups assessed without unsupported claims
criteria.evidence: E96 Q3, E97 Q3/Q5, E98 D, E99-Chapter-III SHAP; no group's contribution is claimed beyond its ablation result.

Map joins 142/142 and labels pass. But Lucena (rank 1 of 41 in Quezon, 5th in the region) uses a 16.8% province value while PSA's own municipal estimates for Lucena are 3.6-8.8% (2003-2018; 6.5% in 2018). With its own 2018 estimate it ranks 14th (E99 Q5). The fix is a one-value data change that needs your approval; it does not affect FIRI.

criteria.criterion: Required evaluation evidence present or objective marked incomplete
criteria.evidence: ISO/IEC 25010: 0 of 50 eligible DA responses; H4: 0 evaluators (packages ready, evaluation/). DOST-FNRI: descriptive only, no NNS 2019 regional figure. Objective 5 and H4/H5 are marked incomplete.

Backend full suite 613 passed, 18 skipped, 0 failed (backend_test_log.txt); frontend vitest 15 files / 75 tests passed; vite build succeeded (local, not deployed). Software tests do not show forecasting validity.
